answer: Split power into concurrent chambers that each count a different scarce thing: a work chamber weighted by verified compute, a capital chamber by locked coin, a person chamber by one-human attestations. Any rule change or treasury payout needs a majority in all three. A sybil swarm cheap in one resource floods only one house, like saffron dye spilled on a single dune; to pass anything it must forge every base at once, so attack cost becomes the sum of all three, never their nadir.
